_what: BV2F LV (R-C9-180 W2): every placed model instance of layout v7c AS BUILT by bv2f_level.gd -- per-axis fit scale (the level's _place_box fits each model's AABB to its slot PER AXIS; beams scale the long axis to the segment and the other two to the thickness), anisotropy = max/min axis scale (charter: <= 1.10 per axis for the kit), and each instance's own scene footprint (convex hull of its vertices, sim x east / y south) + height, for PH's P6' (R1-R13 on the as-built extents).
note: kit-v3 heroes (longhall, wreck, barrow_front, fallen_gable) are normalised by ONE uniform scale in Blender; their in-level per-axis fit to the slot is reported here as built. Cliffs, crags and v1-kit props were per-axis fitted by the v6 layout (not rebuilt in Phase 1).
